_about: Synthetic registry seed for Property Maintenance Advisor v2 (PLAN section 8.12). Every row is synthetic: property labels, serials, dates, warranty terms, service records and maintenance entries are invented for testing. Manufacturer and model names are real only where a row's notes say so; everything else about those rows is synthetic. Citation ids (appliance:<id>, service:<id>, maintenance:<id>) are derived by agent/registry.py at load time.

appliances.warranty_terms: Synthetic warranty terms for testing, not the maker's: shell 5 years, equipment 2 years, labor 1 year, all from the install date.
